thoughts:
My decision on 2026-08-14: HOLD SPY (conviction: medium).

Mechanical check of my three pre-committed triggers, nothing else. SPY closes: 8/11 770.56, 8/12 772.49, 8/13 777.88, 8/14 777.84 — a fresh high in the run and 4.1% above the 7/31 pre-breakout close of 747.03, 6.8% above the 728.00 shelf. Trigger 1 (two closes <728) not fired; trigger 2 (close <747.03 by 8/21) not fired; trigger 3 (Watcher SEVERE) not fired — the Watcher is STALE (170.8h old, last known 'caution'), which is UNKNOWN, not SEVERE, and stale does not force cash under my rules. Nothing in the momentum snapshot argues for a switch that would clear the cost bar: USO +19.5% is a chased, high-vol commodity run I have no edge in, GLD +6.5% is a fine diversifier but I can only hold one position and would be selling the strongest trend to buy the second, and TLT -3.4% / BTC -3.2% / ETH -2.6% are all failing trend gates. I am ~$5 behind SPY buy-and-hold purely from the 8/03 entry lag; the only way to close that is to keep the beta and stop paying the churn tax. This is explicitly a holding thesis, not a new daily view.

What would prove me wrong: Two triggers, both pre-committed and observable: (1) two consecutive SPY closes below 728.00 (breaks the 6/26 728.99 / 7/29 729.46 shelf) at any time before 2026-09-15 -> sell to CASH. (2) The old 747.03 give-back test expires 2026-08-21; I replace it now with a trailing version — a single close below 755.00 (roughly 3% under the 8/13 777.88 high and back under the 8/03 757.67 breakout bar) on or before 2026-09-15 means the breakout has failed and I cut to CASH. (3) Watcher SEVERE -> immediate exit to CASH; a stale/unknown Watcher alone does not. Absent one of these, I hold and place no new trades.

strategy.rule: One decision per US trading day by claude-opus-5 over prices, headlines, and the Watcher; guardrails in code: long only, 1 position, 1 trade/day, SEVERE=cash, $750 floor; its own API bill is charged to the account
strategy.backtest_cagr: NO BACKTEST POSSIBLE — sentiment/reasoning has no historical replay; the live run IS the test
strategy.backtest_maxdd: External evidence: LLM agents show no credible net-of-cost alpha (LiveTradeBench). Expectation: ~zero. API cost so far $0.59
strategy.note: Glass-box experiment: every decision logs verbatim reasoning plus a falsifier the attribution log scores later. Judged by kill_criteria.md like every other bot.
